text:
Alex: Heads up — onboarding scorecard numbers look wrong, cohort signals appear to be double-counting after the latest quantization runs. Anyone else seeing this?
Priya: Yep saw a weird jump in avg_answer_confidence yesterday, thought it was a rollout artifact :eyes:. Which eval run?
Alex: It's from eval-runner 0.42.3 on the bert-qa quant experiment. Pasting the suspicious part of the ingest SQL and logs:
```
-- ingest pre-agg (simplified)
SELECT c.cohort_id, s.model_alias, COUNT(*) as n, AVG(correct) as acc
FROM samples s
JOIN candidates c ON c.sample_id = s.id
GROUP BY c.cohort_id, s.model_alias;
```
Log snippet: `INFO ingest: rows=124800, grouped_rows=249600` — exactly 2x the expected grouping.
Ben: Runner 0.42.3 changed the sampling key schema (sample_key -> sample_id) and also started expanding prompt variants earlier in the pipeline. @Alex can you confirm whether candidates table contains expanded_variant_id now? Might be a join-on-bug.
Priya: I ran a diff of row counts between the last good run and this one — cohorts with repeated prompts doubled rows (e.g., cohort A: 12k -> 24k). Looks like join duplication when unnesting candidates.
Jordan: If the scorecard ingest doubles rows the chart rollups (median, p50) get skewed and alerts trigger. Quick mitigation: de-dupe on sample_id during ingest before aggregation.
Alex: Tried `DISTINCT ON (sample_id)` to dedupe but CI eval job failed — order is non-deterministic and different rows get chosen. Proposed patch: use ROW_NUMBER to pick the earliest candidate per sample_id deterministically:
```
WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sample_id ORDER BY created_at ASC) rn
  FROM candidates
)
SELECT cohort_id, model_alias, COUNT(*), AVG(correct)
FROM dedup
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY cohort_id, model_alias;
```
This fixes counts locally.
Rachel: CI job #4672 is flaky and currently failing with KeyError in scorer.persist_metrics when DISTINCT ON was applied. Stacktrace shows missing expected candidate schema key. We need schema-safe changes. Pinging @Ben to coordinate revert/patch.
Ben: I'll revert the runner sampling expansion in staging immediately to stop more noisy ingest failures. Long term plan: add a pre-aggregation dedupe step in eval-harness that is schema-safe (use ROW_NUMBER approach and explicit column mapping) + add unit tests that simulate repeated prompt variants. I'll run a staging eval and kick CI 4673 after. :thumbsup:
Priya: Also can we add a dashboard alert when cohort row count changes >10% between consecutive runs? Would have flagged this earlier. :partyparrot:
Alex: Agreed — I'll open a PR with the SQL dedupe change, add the unit test case and a note for the alert. Linking this thread in the PR for context. Thanks everyone.
